description: Constants of the IV-band relation fitted to 11 donor-free homoleptic structures (unsubstituted and tert-butyl Lu, Y, La; octamethyl Y; LuPc2 rotation scan 25-40 deg; CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP at PBE0-D3BJ/def2-SVP geometries), the donor correction and the experimental scale factors. The Ca form is the primary form.
donor_correction: nu = nu_relation * (1 + c * D_sub), where D_sub is the substituent share of the IV hole minus that of the particle (natural transition orbitals, code/nto_partition.py); D_sub = 0 without heteroatom donors. The scale factors apply to the corrected relation.
validity: Homoleptic double-deckers with skew angles from about 25 deg (lowest fitted point; coupling node near 20 deg) to 45 deg. Heteroleptic sandwiches are outside the calibration.
